title: A note on the lower bounds of the first nonzero Steklov eigenvalue on compact manifolds
summary: Let $(Ω^{n+1}, g)$ be an $(n+1)$-dimensional smooth compact connected Riemannian manifold with smooth boundary $Σ$, satisfying that ${\text{Ric}_Ω}\ge 0$ and $Σ$ is strictly convex, more precisely, its second fundamental form $h\ge cg_Σ$ for some positive constant $c$. Escobar {\cite{escobar1997geometry}} considered the first nonzero Steklov eigenvalue $σ_1$ of $(Ω^{n+1}, g)$ and proved that $σ_1\geq c$ when $n=1$ and $σ_1>{\frac{c}{2}}$ when $n \geq 2$.
